name: iter20_anchor
description: EXPERIMENT A - the anchor, run long. The companion paper's operating point (sigma 0.5, alpha 0.5, both CONSTANT) in the new-only regime over 20 iterations, 15 seeds, one detector. Purpose is to display the decay: guidance holds a real advantage while the induced gap still exists, then loses it as the gap is filled and finally reverses, because the detector must keep returning an argmax after there is no structural deficit left to find. Read alongside det_iou / det_distance / det_drift, which show the target dissolving.
